evidence.chart_evidence: "Mars has no strength of its own in Libra, you cannot easily tell... whether the closing-off was proportionate" works detriment; Moon square Neptune/Uranus only cited.
evidence.specificity: Scene is generic ("someone reads you and gets it wrong"); the aftermath is present, but there is no concrete recurring moment.
evidence.synthesis: The close names a tension but ends on the Neptune sextile as a way in, which softens it; the Mars-chain subsections overlap.
evidence.contradiction_handling: The cost is left standing ("the gap... is yours alone to carry"), but "a rare point of entry" is a rescue and the Mars/Pluto roles blur.
evidence.anti_cliche: Scorpio total, sealed and guarded rests on archetype; the Mars-in-12 private relitigating is chart-specific but is the only such claim.
evidence.psychological_depth: "a finished performance of certainty... the weighing has already happened somewhere Mars could not be watched" is a mechanism.
evidence.practical_usefulness: The reader gets the pattern of a sudden shutdown, but the situations are generic and the reader must locate them.
evidence.voice_quality: Antithesis is dense ("not hidden... it is", "not new... but", "rather than" several times) and "a rare point of entry" is a borrowed phrase.
evidence.falsifiability: "People read intensity off you immediately" and "you experience an absolute one" would read as true for most readers, and their negations are arguable.

results.critique:
ANTITHESIS-TIC FAILURE — the contrastive "X rather than Y" construction (and its variants "not X but Y", "less a X than Y") is too DENSE. One paragraph carries 2 of them (7 in the section); the CADENCE ALLOWANCE permits at most one per paragraph. The instances: "rather than", "rather than", "rather than", "rather than", "rather than", "rather than", "rather than". Keep the most load-bearing one in each affected paragraph and rewrite the rest as direct statements — say what the placement does, not what it does instead of. Do not swap in another antithesis frame or a dash-balanced equivalent; this is the cadence half of PROSE FAILURE MODES #1, so varying the wording while keeping the shape does not fix it.

Specificity: replace the abstract confrontation with one drawn recurring moment (trigger, action, aftermath) set in the first house. Voice: cut the contrastive constructions to at most one per paragraph ("not hidden... but", "not new... but", "rather than graduated", "rather than reinforcing", "rather than the settled certainty"); remove the "rare point of entry" flattery and the "first thing to understand" framing. Contradiction: end on the cost without the Neptune reassurance. Synthesis: sharpen the single tension (Pluto's fixity against the Mars-12 private weighing) and avoid re-stating the Mars chain in the close. Falsifiability: replace the "people read intensity" claim with something a neighbouring Scorpio chart could contradict. Preserve the Mars-chain mechanism and the orb handling.

evidence.chart_evidence: Neecha bhanga and Mercury antardasha are cited, but "Debilitated in its own house" is wrong, and the Mars kendra claim is unworked.
evidence.specificity: Arena and live condition are named, but "most rooms you currently enter" is vague and nothing ties it to a factor.
evidence.synthesis: The close is a dasha timing wrap with no live tension and no cost. Paragraphs 3 and 4 both restate the deficit.
evidence.contradiction_handling: The fall stands as a cost, but "the fall is real, but it is not total collapse" softens it, and the yoga is partly rescued.
evidence.anti_cliche: "a mind constantly revising itself and a depth that does not let go" comes from this chart's conjunctions, not sign keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: Names restlessness when belonging feels like containment, but never says why it formed or what it protects against.
evidence.practical_usefulness: "it is most active anywhere your standing has not yet been tested" names a condition, but the pattern is hard to spot.
evidence.voice_quality: The "not X" antithesis recurs: "not ease but structure", "rather than settled", "not total collapse". Also "simply" twice and "actually"-style filler.
evidence.falsifiability: "a need for your sense of self to stay unfixed" would fail inversion, but "revised and re-presented" fits almost anyone.

results.critique: Fix the factual error: the Sun is debilitated in Libra, which is Venus's sign, not "its own house". Work Mars's kendra from the Moon properly. Name one live tension in the close, such as needing steadiness while Swati demands movement, and show what it costs. Stop the second and third paragraphs from restating the same deficit. Remove "not ease but structure" and "rather than settled", and use the contrastive construction at most once. Cut "simply", "sense of worth" and "people experience". Say what the restlessness protects against, and make the quiet and live conditions concrete, for example in terms of the eleventh house and community. Keep the nakshatra opening, the frame shift statement and the dasha transition caveat.

evidence.chart_evidence: Mostly anchored, but claims Mars cancellation 'from the Moon' yet omits Mars Libra; also 'Mars moves out of structural failure' and wide Jupiter opposition leaned on; Pluto/Mars chain cited more than worked.
evidence.specificity: Scenes are generic ('first minute of an unfamiliar exchange'); no aftermath beyond abstract 'two audits running'; no trigger aspect from the plan.
evidence.synthesis: Ends with a bare list of unresolved bodies; no close naming one live tension or its cost; sections re-arrive at same 'private/audit' note.
evidence.contradiction_handling: Both frames held, nothing rescued, but tensions stated not inhabited; 'tempers the account' cancellation softens the Sun fall.
evidence.anti_cliche: Scorpio probing hidden motive and Libra fairness audit lean on sign keywords; little needing this chart's combination.
evidence.psychological_depth: Describes the stalled-versus-revised pattern but gives little on why it formed or what the person wrongly believes.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Patterns are recognisable (weighed-down confrontation, immersion without checking) but situations are generic and reader must locate them.
evidence.voice_quality: Antithesis tic repeats ('not ease but', 'does not ask… asks', 'rather than', 'instead of') within paragraphs; 'sits beneath rather than beside'; repeated 'one account… the other' shape.
evidence.falsifiability: Central Mars claim is chart-specific, but 'two audits running' and 'intensity they did not choose' would fit most readers.

Give each divergence a distinct scene triggered by a plan aspect (Mars–Saturn sextile, Mars–Jupiter opposition, Sun–Pluto conjunction), with action under each frame and what the person registers afterwards. Replace sign-keyword descriptions (Scorpio probing, Libra fairness) with consequences from dispositor chains. Remove repeated 'not X but Y', 'rather than' and 'instead of' constructions; vary paragraph endings. Add one mechanism: what the person wrongly believes about the delayed confrontation. evidence.chart_evidence: Mars detriment in H12 worked as dispositor: "the mechanism meant to carry it out... is the part of you least equipped"; Pluto orb used.
evidence.specificity: Scene has trigger (someone withdraws), action (ask the direct question) and aftermath ("left having laid yourself bare in a way that can't be walked back").
evidence.synthesis: Close names a mismatch and its cost, but resolves in a tidy structural summary re-listing Pluto, Mars, Neptune; no one cross-reference is newly combined.
evidence.contradiction_handling: Costs stand uncompensated, but "rarer than it sounds" is a P1 phrase; tension between Sun and Mars is stated more than inhabited.
evidence.anti_cliche: Opening leans on Scorpio keywords (depth, merger, withheld exposure); "intensity... the Scorpio charge is already in the room" is archetype-driven.
evidence.psychological_depth: "they arrive as one demand... because they've never been available to you separately" explains mechanism of fused drives and the cost.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Named pattern: meeting a withdrawing person head-on at full intensity; recognisable trigger for the reader.
evidence.voice_quality: Repeated antithesis in close paragraph ("not a flaw... so much as", "instead of") and "does not add... so much as"; "cooperative rather than fused" close by.
evidence.falsifiability: Central Pluto claim (no lower gear, meets change head-on) is falsifiable; "you rarely get to reveal yourself gradually" and "hunger for real contact" survive negation.

Apply the deletion test: if removing the clause leaves the astrological claim intact, cut it. Replace each with either the strength's plain function or the load-bearing mechanism it performs against a named difficulty — never reassurance about how rare, valuable, or underrated it is.

Synthesis: close should not re-list Pluto/Mars/Neptune; name one live tension and show it lived in the already-drawn withdrawal scene, combining one cross-reference freshly. Contradiction: delete "rarer than it sounds"; let the Neptune sextile stand as plain function and keep the Mars-Sun gap as a cost, not a structural summary. Voice: cut contrastive constructions to at most one per paragraph ("so much as", "rather than", "not a flaw... so much as", "instead of"). Anti-cliche/falsifiability: replace generic Scorpio depth/merger lines and "hunger for real contact" with claims specific to Mars H12 Libra detriment and Moon-Uranus cross-purpose. Preserve chart_evidence, specificity, depth and usefulness: the Pluto scene, Mars dispositor work.

evidence.chart_evidence: Mars as lord of Aries in a kendra from the Moon worked as partial cancellation; Rahu lordship named.
evidence.specificity: Arena (first house) and live condition named, but no quiet condition; 'has nowhere immediate to land' is the only gesture.
evidence.synthesis: Close is dasha timing with no live tension or cost; 'not three separate forces' paragraph repeats the compounding point.
evidence.contradiction_handling: 'This does not undo the difficulty... not that the struggle stops being a struggle' leaves the fall as a standing cost.
evidence.anti_cliche: No sign cliché, but 'bend without breaking' and 'wind' lean on the Swati keywords; Libra fairness reading is archetypal.
evidence.psychological_depth: 'standing uncertainty about whether your own presence is justified' hints at a mechanism but never says why it formed or what it protects.
evidence.practical_usefulness: No situation named in which the pattern fires; the reader learns about the chart more than about themselves.
evidence.voice_quality: Repeated 'not X; it is Y' constructions, several 'not X but Y' in the first two paragraphs, and 'actually'-style hedging flatten the register.
evidence.falsifiability: Central claim, that the fall makes assertion costly, is chart-specific; 'standing uncertainty about whether your presence is justified' negates plausibly for many readers.

results.critique: Fix synthesis: the close must name one live tension (e.g. Libra's weighing against the Sun's need to assert, or freedom against merger) and show what inhabiting it costs, with Ketu/Mercury timing serving that tension. Cut the 'one compound unit' paragraph, which restates earlier sections. Specificity and usefulness: name the arena concretely and when the pattern goes quiet (for example when the weighing has time, or when no one has made a claim). Name the recognisable situations in which it fires, without inventing a scene. Depth: say why the self-doubt forms and what the hedging protects against. Voice: cut the 'not X; it is Y' and 'not X but Y' constructions to at most one per two paragraphs, and drop 'wind' filler. Preserve: the chart anchoring (neecha bhanga condition, eleventh-house lordship, drishti to an empty seventh house) and the uncompensated treatment of the fall.

evidence.chart_evidence: Detriment versus enemy's-sign weighed to decide which Mars account carries more pressure. The Sun's fall is paired with its cancellation. The Sidereal Jupiter Pisces boundary is never mentioned, which is a miss.
evidence.specificity: Scenes have trigger, action and aftermath: 'still totting up the ledger of whose claim outweighs whose, long after the exchange has ended.'
evidence.synthesis: No closing paragraph naming one live tension and its cost. It ends on a one-clause list of the unresolved placements. The Ascendant scene reuses the verdict-held-privately note from Mars.
evidence.contradiction_handling: Costs stand open: 'a thorough diagnosis that may never convert into an actual change.' Mars account left unresolved. No rescue found.
evidence.anti_cliche: Libra-Mars 'defers out of fairness' versus Virgo-Mars 'defers out of standard' comes from the chart's combination of factors, not sign keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: Mechanism given: 'what they believe they owe the delay: fairness to someone else, or fidelity to their own exacting standard.'
evidence.practical_usefulness: Named patterns with situations: 'a confrontation is actually warranted'; 'a disagreement that turns personal'; a stalled regimen.
evidence.voice_quality: Heavy antithesis density, e.g. 'not a milder and a sharper', 'rather than', 'not two moods... they are'. Repeated 'Picture/Imagine/Consider' openers. 'Actually' is overused, and 'simply' appears twice.

evidence.chart_evidence: "will it gives you can only be carried out through Mars... in Libra in the twelfth house in detriment"; dispositor drives the argument.
evidence.specificity: Control scene has trigger and action; the aftermath is present ("resentment... no one to be resolved with"), but the scene is told once and not returned to.
evidence.synthesis: Close names the first-house Sun versus twelfth-house ruler and its cost ("distance whose cause you understand and they cannot locate"); Moon paragraph leans toward listing.
evidence.contradiction_handling: "The cost comes in repair and in credit" is left standing; the Neptune sextile reads "Capricorn restraint" mildly as a gift.
evidence.anti_cliche: "the room has already adjusted to you, guarded or deferring" comes from Sun-H1 plus a H12 Mars, not from sign keywords; the depth/power language leans on Scorpio archetype.
evidence.psychological_depth: "Reading the undercurrent can stand in for saying what you want... perceiving that much feels like having acted" gives a mechanism and a false belief.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Names the pattern and its trigger: "Someone moves to decide something that concerns you without asking"; the reader can recognise it.
evidence.voice_quality: Varied sentence length and British register; "X rather than Y"-style contrasts recur ("not something you decide to show", "easier to hold than to act from") and the Moon paragraph is flat.
evidence.falsifiability: "you act later and privately, in a form the other person may never connect" negates falsely for most; "keep intensity private" is weaker.

evidence.chart_evidence: Mars lord of Aries, kendra from Moon, 'earned privately and stays out of sight' works the cancellation.
evidence.specificity: Live: 'whenever your standing depends on a counterpart's response'; quiet: 'moving between positions and nobody's definition... pressed.' Quiet clause is thin.
evidence.synthesis: Close names the dasha timing but no single open tension with a cost; 'holding it harder than letting it go' is mild.
evidence.contradiction_handling: 'Sources weigh this differently. It qualifies the debilitation without removing it' leaves cost standing; Swati capacity carries no reassurance.
evidence.anti_cliche: 'agreed your way out of a view you held an hour earlier' comes from Swati plus fall, not Libra keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: 'your claim to be someone in particular tends to wait for a counterweight before it feels legitimate.'
evidence.practical_usefulness: Pattern named with situations: 'pinned in place, by a role or by someone else's fixed definition' registers as constriction first.
evidence.voice_quality: Paragraph endings differ ('...a view you held an hour earlier.' vs 'harder than letting it go'), but 'not supplied by its dispositor' and 'rather' contrasts recur.
evidence.falsifiability: Negation of 'identity is worked out in speech' is endorsable for most readers; 'staying movable' and 'agree your way out' are fairly Barnum-like.

results.critique: Synthesis: close on one live tension and its cost (e.g. Swati's need for movement against the fall Sun's need for a counterweight, and what yielding costs now in the Ketu/Mercury period), not a dasha recap. Falsifiability: replace broadly endorsable lines ('you discover who you are by saying it', 'bending until little centre is left') with claims tied to Swati pada 3, Pluto's 16° conjunction or the 11th-house lordship that a different chart would contradict. Preserve the worked Neecha Bhanga argument, the live/quiet condition, and the plain debilitation cost.

evidence.chart_evidence: Tropical Mars compromised by sign and dispositor; Sidereal Venus Raja Yoga with Saturn binds Lagna ruler. One slip: Mars-Saturn sextile 'Saturn second in both frames' used as trigger.
evidence.specificity: Scenes (first meeting, shifted loyalty) have trigger and aftermath but are generic; the Mars scene invents a financial-terms setting not in the evidence.
evidence.synthesis: Close names two gates and a cost each but ends on 'whichever cost they noticed first', a mild wrap; also states Jupiter 'ruled by Mars' and claims Sidereal Mars/Jupiter chain loosely.
evidence.contradiction_handling: Cost left standing: 'a claim surrendered, or a holding never trusted'; 'no promise of ease' on Harsha. Nothing rescued.
evidence.anti_cliche: 'Hasta asks for the work of the hands, and the correction happens on the object itself' needs this chart's nakshatra, not sign keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: Names behaviours and outcomes ('slow to revise', 'unsure the grievance was theirs') but gives little mechanism for why the patterns formed or what they protect against.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Scenes name situations (first meeting, loyalty shift), but the pattern is split across two frames and little is recognisable as one lived pattern.
evidence.voice_quality: Uniform report-like sentence shapes; repeated 'Under the Tropical account… Under the Sidereal account…' template across all four scenes becomes a rhythm.
evidence.falsifiability: 'they leave holding a private verdict about who in the room can be trusted' is specific; negation reads false for this chart.

results.critique: Vary the repeated 'Under the Tropical account… Under the Sidereal account…' template across scenes; each divergence needs its own sentence shape and image. Fix the Mars scene: the evidence gives no financial or contractual trigger, so draw it from the Mars-Saturn sextile's discipline/commitment function only. Deepen psychological mechanism: say what each frame's behaviour protects against and what the person wrongly believes about it. Make the scenes more concrete and recognisable, with an interior aftermath rather than a summary verdict. Let the close show what inhabiting the open divergence costs in a lived moment rather than a tidy two-gate summary. Preserve the chart anchoring, the plain statement of costs, and the boundary-note handling.

evidence.chart_evidence: "Your Sun is peregrine in Scorpio... runs through Mars... in Libra in the twelfth, in detriment" drives the argument; Neptune's fifth-house rulership is asserted without being derived.
evidence.specificity: Trigger "someone... moves to set the terms", action "You go still", aftermath "That night, the contest... plays out in full in your head"; the aftermath is not returned to later.
evidence.synthesis: Close names two settings with no chosen timing and the cost, "bound to the stance your silence implied"; the first-house and close lean on the Mars-weighing claim twice.
evidence.contradiction_handling: Cost left standing: "you often end up defending a firmness you have not yet reached"; the closing "rarely give yourself credit" is a soft edge.
evidence.anti_cliche: "decisions are made offstage... already negotiated with every side" comes from the Scorpio-Mars-in-Libra combination, not from sign keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: "the wish to know everything becomes a need to know it first, and the loyalty... turns watchful" explains the mechanism; it is not followed through to a cause.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Names the pattern and its trigger: "someone in the room moves to set the terms, or asks you to show your hand".
evidence.voice_quality: Antithesis recurs: "manage that reaction rather than enjoy it", "The decision itself tends to happen later"; the structure "X. The chart shows Y" is repeated; the close is dense but uniform.
evidence.falsifiability: Claim that the room reads stillness as a verdict while Mars is still weighing is chart-specific; "you may believe you are the decisive one" is partly endorsable.

results.critique: Voice: cut the contrastive constructions ("manage that reaction rather than enjoy it", the "decisive presence / decision happens later" pairing) so none fall within a paragraph of another. Vary paragraph-final sentence shapes; several end on a similar stated-cost cadence. Stop restating the "Mars weighs in private" claim in the first-house paragraphs, the Pluto paragraph and the close. Preserve the scene, the ruler-chain work and the practical pattern.

evidence.chart_evidence: Venus detriment 'testing whatever it is offered before trusting it'; Mars kendra from Moon cancellation named and weighed.
evidence.specificity: Arena and live condition named ('standing has to be set in front of people'); quiet condition 'when you are moving' tied to Swati; the eleventh-house arena is worked.
evidence.synthesis: Close names an open version of self, but is mostly dasha timing; no cost of inhabiting a tension is shown.
evidence.contradiction_handling: 'The effort ... remains, and nothing elsewhere in this frame pays it back.' The debilitation is left standing as a cost; 'generous and free of performance' is a mild soft edge.
evidence.anti_cliche: Mercury 'sends your statements back for revision before they leave you' comes from this chart's combination, not sign keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: A self that waits for the scales to settle; Mercury rewording statements twice. This is mechanism-adjacent, but there is little on why it formed.
evidence.practical_usefulness: The pattern is clear, with situations named (friends, peers), but the reader has to locate it themselves; little is recognisable moment to moment.
evidence.voice_quality: Several 'X, not Y' and 'rather than' contrasts cluster. Sentences are uniform in shape and the 'Libra alone would ask only for balance; Swati adds' pivot is formulaic.
evidence.falsifiability: 'Stating yourself only after checking how the exchange is balanced' is a Libra-keyword claim whose negation is arguable. 'Easier to drop an old description than finish a new one' is broadly endorsable.

results.critique: Synthesis: the close should name one live tension, such as Swati's need to move against the eleventh-house need to be counted among peers, and show what inhabiting it costs. Do not end on timing alone. Falsifiability: replace broadly endorsable lines ('drop an old description than finish a new one', 'checks the scales') with claims that exclude other charts, tied to the Mercury retrograde and Pluto conjunction. Voice: cut the contrastive constructions to one per two paragraphs, vary sentence shapes, and avoid the 'Libra alone... Swati adds' template. Practical usefulness: give the reader a named pattern with a situation they could spot, such as the moment among peers when posture shifts. Preserve the chart evidence (Venus detriment, Mars cancellation) and the uncompensated debilitation.

evidence.chart_evidence: "two detriment planets each depend on the other"; crossed rulers Mars-in-Libra / Venus-in-Scorpio drive the Ascendant argument. Sun-Neptune sextile is named, not worked.
evidence.specificity: Jupiter-Uranus scene: "holding a better routine that exists only in outline"; ends "more capable and more heavily loaded". Other scenes thinner on aftermath.
evidence.synthesis: Close names crossed rulership and cost: "no stance... arrives unquestioned by its own ruler". But the Sun and Ascendant scenes (agreement, group settling) overlap in deference themes.
evidence.contradiction_handling: "The other party may never learn there was a dispute to settle" stands as an uncompensated cost. The Harsha Yoga competence framing is a mild soft edge.
evidence.anti_cliche: Characterisations come from crossed rulers and dignities, e.g. "accepted terms they are still checking", not from sign keywords.
evidence.psychological_depth: Mostly behaviour description. Only partial mechanism: "suspicion that prompted the test keeps running after the matter has closed". Little on why it formed or what is falsely believed.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Situations named (first meeting with easy agreement, group settling) but patterns are tied to chart mechanics; the reader finishes better informed about the two frames than about themselves.
evidence.voice_quality: Many paragraph-final sentences share a flat declarative shape, and "Under the Tropical... Under the Sidereal..." repeats in every scene. Antithesis is used sparingly, which is fine.
evidence.falsifiability: Central claim (no stance arrives unquestioned by its own ruler) is chart-specific. But "they defer their claim until the group's balance is clear" and "come away with a position they feel completely" are broadly endorsable.

results.critique: Add mechanism: say why the pattern formed, what it protects against, and what this person wrongly believes about it (psychological_depth). Vary the scene template: stop repeating "Under the Tropical account... Under the Sidereal account..." in every scene, and vary paragraph-final sentence shapes (voice_quality). Make the Sun and group-settling scene distinct from the Ascendant first-meeting scene, and give each a sharper trigger and an aftermath the reader could recognise next week (practical_usefulness). Replace broadly endorsable claims such as deferring until balance is clear with ones a neighbouring chart could falsify, tied to specific orbs or dignities (falsifiability). Preserve the strong crossed-ruler close, the chart evidence work and the boundary handling.

evidence.chart_evidence: Mars detriment in twelfth drives defence: "the defence of that centre is rarely direct"; Neptune rulership of Pisces linked to fifth.
evidence.specificity: Pluto scene has trigger and action; aftermath "the relationship now carries a debt that only you know exists"; the Neptune scene is thinner.
evidence.synthesis: Close names the will bargaining in private, but it re-arrives at the Pluto scene's claim and ends on "fully present and fully understood".
evidence.contradiction_handling: "you win the power question by going still, and you lose the argument you never made" stands as an uncompensated cost.
evidence.anti_cliche: "gets reasoned into balance, and comes back days later as a settled verdict you never stated aloud" needs the Mars-Libra chain.
evidence.psychological_depth: "the twelfth-house Mars has quietly filed it as a grievance" explains the mechanism of withdrawal and the debt it creates.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Names situations: "A partner pushes for a concession, a superior reframes your work, or a friend decides what you 'really' meant."
evidence.voice_quality: Antithesis clusters ("fixed, total... works out of sight"; "not argue... withdraw"), "You register" repeated; closing lapse "fully present and fully understood".
evidence.falsifiability: "You go very still... withdraw the access" would be false for a Scorpio who confronts directly; the claim inverts.

results.critique: Synthesis: the close restates the Pluto scene's cost (private grievance, unspoken self) instead of naming a fresh tension, and it ends on a tidy double ("fully present and fully understood") that resolves by addition. Name one live tension, for example the fixed identity against a Mars that negotiates in private, and show a new situation in which it costs something. Voice: cut repeated contrast constructions and the "You register / You know / You tend" rhythm, and vary sentence openings. Preserve the Pluto scene, the Mars chain, and the plain cost statements.

evidence.chart_evidence: "Mars, lord of Aries... sits in a kendra from the Moon" worked into twelfth-house route; but Pluto, Swati and Ketu are only briefly worked.
evidence.specificity: Names arena and live condition: "first meetings, negotiations over your own terms"; quiet: "where the terms are already fixed and fair".
evidence.synthesis: Closing names a test of stating what you want once, but no cost is shown and the subsections don't combine into one tension.
evidence.contradiction_handling: "The cost is plain... that effort does not lessen with practice"; neecha bhanga "does not erase it". Soft edge: "Your capacity here is real and specific".
evidence.anti_cliche: Libra-as-accommodating-diplomat reading leans on sign keywords; Swati bending and 'wait for the other side' are largely archetypal.
evidence.psychological_depth: "you feel it as a refusal to be cornered into one definitive version of yourself" gives a mechanism, though the origin is thin.
evidence.practical_usefulness: Pattern named with situations: "you feel the effort it takes to say 'I want this' without first measuring how it will land".
evidence.voice_quality: Repeated 'X, not Y' and 'does not erase it' shapes; "Your capacity here is real and specific" is a borrowed rescue-style phrase.
evidence.falsifiability: Central claim (claims form slowly and qualified) inverts, but 'cool welcome registers as a verdict about you' and 'steadiness from adjusting gracefully' are broadly endorsable.

results.critique: Synthesis: close on one live tension, such as stating a want once against Mercury's revising, and show what inhabiting it costs, rather than adding the dasha as a final note. Anti-cliche and falsifiability: replace generic Libra-accommodation and 'verdict about you' lines with claims produced by Swati pada 3, Pluto at 16°13' on the Sun, and Ketu's loosening that a neighbouring chart could falsify. Voice: cut the closing capacity sentence ('real and specific', 'steadiness comes from adjusting gracefully') or give it a mechanism, and vary the negation-then-assertion shapes ('It does not erase it', 'not X'). Preserve the specificity of arena and quiet condition, the plain statement of the debilitation cost, and the neecha bhanga handling.

evidence.chart_evidence: "detriment rests on a detriment dispositor" drives the claim that Tropical Mars carries more pressure than Sidereal.

The close re-lists the ruler chain; instead name one tension and show what inhabiting it costs in a lived moment. Psychological depth: add a mechanism, say why detriment-Mars withholding formed and what it protects against, and what the person wrongly believes about their delay. results.critique: Voice: reduce contrastive constructions so no paragraph carries two ("available rather than automatic" beside "works as perception and stops working as defence", the opening "The conviction is complete. Move the Moon cross-purpose sentences out of the Neptune subsection's quiet-condition paragraph, or integrate them. evidence.chart_evidence: Dispositor Venus weighing resources drives "self-assertion depends on a planet that will not trust what it holds"; Ketu claim thin.

results.critique: Synthesis: the closing paragraph is a dasha forecast that leaves no live tension open. Name one tension (Swati's need to stay free against the Libra Sun's need for a counterweight) and show what inhabiting it costs. Avoid re-deriving Mercury's retrograde turning-over already covered in the Mercury section; build on it in one clause. evidence.practical_usefulness: Named situations (obligation slipping, first meeting, remark landing carelessly) with what they are left holding; recognisable.
evidence.voice_quality: Repeated "Under the X account... Under the Y account" frame in every scene; several "not X" contrasts; flat uniform shape.
evidence.falsifiability: Central claim (broker vs correct) is falsifiable, but "left with the matter unsettled" and "more scope and a workload with no visible edge" are broadly endorsable.

results.critique: Vary the scene template: stop repeating "Under the Tropical account... Under the Sidereal account... They are left holding" in every divergence; change shape, order and sentence length. Deepen mechanism: say what the brokering or correcting protects against, and what the person wrongly believes about it. The close needs one live tension with its lived cost, not a note on misreading; the Ascendant divergence should say which account is under more pressure instead of calling them comparable. Sharpen the Sun and Jupiter outcomes so they exclude other charts, tied to Sun-Pluto 0.4° and Jupiter-Uranus 1.6°. Trim the contrastive constructions. results.critique: Voice: avoid repeated short declarative closers ("The perception arrives fast.", "The alertness waits for the next test.") and the contrastive constructions that fall close together; vary paragraph-final sentence shapes. results.critique: Synthesis: the close should name one live tension and show what inhabiting it costs. results.critique: Synthesis: the close restates "negotiate vs correct, wound vs debt" and ends with "neither one cancels the other", a flattening closer. Name one live tension (e.g. Mars-Saturn: promise held versus grievance unspoken) and show what living inside it costs, in a specific moment. The second..." parallelism and the "It is X." fragment close. Reduce the "X, and not Y" contrasts to one per two paragraphs. results.critique: Voice: vary the repeated 'Under the Tropical account... Under the Sidereal account...' frame and the parallel 'X in Tropical; Y in Sidereal' closing sentences across Mars, Sun and Jupiter. Avoid stacking contrasts such as 'one account strains at disclosure, the other at what can be kept' near other antitheses. Break the uniform short declarative rhythm with longer, subordinated sentences. Preserve the chart anchoring, the three-part scenes, the dignity-based pressure ranking and the open close.
